player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Sachmo''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: QMC deck using the new effect.  I always liked the deck, so I thought I would give it a shot.
cards: What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?
Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice
notes: Posted 28 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted with '(s)': Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation (posted 'QMC'), Bespin and Cloud City: Guest Quarters; these count toward the 60. Heading For The Medical Frigate is in the list without '(s)' and is recorded as the starting interrupt; no starting effect is marked.

Posted 'Carbo Chamber' dested the Light Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; 'CC DB' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay), the Light Cloud City docking bay (East Platform is the Dark one) (the strategy uses it for Fallen Portal).
Posted 'Qui-Gonn' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Qui-Gonn's Saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber because Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is a Reflections III card (October 2001), after this June 2001 post.

Posted 'EPP Obi' / 'EPP Luke' / 'EPP Leia' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Luke With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'ECC Lando' dested Lando With Blaster Pistol; 'Cpt Han' dested Captain Han Solo; 'Ackbar' dested Admiral Ackbar.
Posted 'Thanespi' dested First Officer Thaneespi and 'Hassh'n' dested Major Haash'n (the strategy says the deck plays 'all the Mon Calamari guys').

Posted 'Jedi's Resilience' / 'Jedi's Conentration' dested A Jedi's Resilience / A Jedi's Concentration; 'OOC' Out Of Commission; 'SATM' Sorry About The Mess; 'HotJ' Honor Of The Jedi; 'DtF' Draw Their Fire; 'WYTTPOU?' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'DODN/WA' Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Don't Do that Again' is an Effect in 2001.
